payload.text:
**Refining ability behavior handling**

I'm updating the logic so AbilityBehavior no longer receives special treatment during expansion, ensuring expanded values match the base exactly. To avoid misinterpreting AbilityBehavior strings with pipes as per-level numeric lists, I'll detect if the raw string includes a "|" and disable multi-level splitting in that case, keeping behavior flags intact. I'll also remove special copying of AbilityBehavior from derived fields, while still preserving other derived-only fields. This keeps expand consistent with base without breaking existing derived-specific data.

summary.text:
**Refining ability behavior handling**

I'm updating the logic so AbilityBehavior no longer receives special treatment during expansion, ensuring expanded values match the base exactly. To avoid misinterpreting AbilityBehavior strings with pipes as per-level numeric lists, I'll detect if the raw string includes a "|" and disable multi-level splitting in that case, keeping behavior flags intact. I'll also remove special copying of AbilityBehavior from derived fields, while still preserving other derived-only fields. This keeps expand consistent with base without breaking existing derived-specific data.
